prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: wide 16:9 architectural cutaway opening a technical lesson on uninterruptible power and service continuity.
Primary request: A physically plausible data-center electrical support room immediately beside a server hall. A clean isometric architectural cutaway on an off-white background. The dominant subjects are two separate equipment groups in the electrical room: one tall black fully enclosed UPS cabinet with a small display, and a separate battery cabinet with its front door removed to show several neatly enclosed battery modules. The battery cabinet's low-voltage DC terminal connections are covered. A closed low-voltage grey distribution switchboard stands behind the UPS. It has a flat enclosed top and fully enclosed cable entries; NO exposed high-voltage bushings. Compact overhead enclosed cable trays connect the room to a neighboring server hall with three visible black racks. A separate small wall-mounted control panel and blue pump skid at right make cooling controls and pumps visible. Walls separate the spaces with a generous doorway. On the left outside wall, through an open side of the cutaway, show one separate compact enclosed standby generator on its pad, outside the occupied electrical room. Use realistic recognizable equipment proportions. The interior UPS and batteries remain the visual focus. No specific manufacturer identity, no text, no labels, no arrows, no electrical lightning or glowing current, no numbers, no branding, no solar panels, no people. High clarity, professional precise architectural illustration, soft shadows, restrained teal structural accents. No exact as-built installation implied; explanatory connections and labels will be added in deterministic code.

review.physical: Inspected generated output. Generator outdoors, enclosed UPS distinct from batteries, switchboard fully enclosed, racks in adjacent hall. Room arrangement is generic physical context, not an installation layout.
review.limitations: No ratings or technical connections inferred from illustration. Code diagrams establish the current paths. Visible battery modules illustrate storage; no product identity, chemistry or runtime is claimed.
